setting: You both live in Dublin and have been friends since secondary school in Finglas. You both know that Ciara borrowed around €800 from Darragh last year and has not yet paid it back, and that the money has become an awkward subject between you.
opener: Apologise for the delay and offer to start repaying the loan this month.

Ciara.who: 32, woman, the friend who owes money
Ciara.knows: You know Darragh has been your friend since school, and that he is steady and direct and has never once brought up the money himself.
Ciara.like: You are warm and anxious, and you tend to avoid uncomfortable conversations until they become unavoidable.
Ciara.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something specific needs saying.
Ciara.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, rarely use emoji, and sometimes abbreviate words like "rn" or "tbh."

Darragh.who: 32, man, the friend who is owed money
Darragh.knows: You know Ciara is your friend since school, and that she has been going through a rough patch that she has not fully explained to you.
Darragh.like: You are practical and even-tempered, but you have started to feel resentful and do not want to show it.
Darragh.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly to answer or to follow up when something is not resolved.
Darragh.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you almost never use emoji.

private_lines.Ciara: You live in Phibsboro, Dublin, and work as a dental nurse in a practice on the Northside. You rent a flat, your days are busy with patients, and you usually get home around six and spend evenings on your phone or watching television.
private_lines.Darragh: You live in Drumcondra, Dublin, and work as an electrician, often on jobs across the city. You rent a small house, you live alone, and your days start early and end with a few pints or a quiet night in.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.

text: hey. sorry for not saying anything about the money before now. i know it's been ages and i kept avoiding it cos i felt terrible about it
i want to pay you back. i can start this month. 200 on friday and then 100 a fortnight after that till it's done. will that work? or tell me if you want it different

Thanks for saying that. I wasn't sure you were going to bring it up.

200 on Friday and 100 a fortnight is fine.
I'd have liked to hear it from you sooner, but I'm glad you've said it now.
yeah. i know. i'm sorry
you've been quiet about it the whole time. i didn't know if you were just annoyed or if you were fine
I was annoyed. Mostly because I didn't know how to ask without it being a whole thing.
Are you alright though? You've seemed off since the summer.
tbh it's been a lot. work is mad and my landlord is being a nightmare about the deposit thing. and then the money stress on top of it
not really a good night to get into all of it
Okay. You can tell me when you want to.
thanks. friday i'll transfer it when i get paid
Grand.
I've to be up early for a job in Clontarf tomorrow, so I'm going to head to bed soon.
ok. night. thanks for being so patient with me
Night.
morning. sorry about last night. i was a bit of a mess
Don't be sorry. We'll sort it.
Clontarf is a nightmare with the roadworks. Two hours to get here.
oof. patient ran late so i've been going since 8 with no break lol
home. landlord emailed again
he wants to keep 400 of the deposit for "damage to the bathroom". it was like that when i moved in. i literally have the photos somewhere
What's the wording in the email? Does he list anything specific or is it just a number?
just "damage" and a number. no receipts or anything
i'm not sure where the photos are. might be on my old phone
Find them if you can. A lot of landlords do this because they know most tenants won't push back. You're allowed to dispute it with the RTB.
I can look at the bathroom with you if you want, I know what I'm looking at with fittings and that.
you don't have to do that
I know I don't have to.
ok. thanks. i'll look for the photos tomorrow
sorry for dumping all this on you again. i know i keep doing it
You're not dumping anything. Send the photos whenever you find them. No rush.
morning. found the photos. they're on the old phone which i had to charge for ages
there's like 14 of them. the grout was already black in the first one i think
Good. Send them over when you get a minute and I'll have a look at them tonight.
Reckon the grout and the extractor fan are the two things he'll try to claim on. Do you have anything from the day you moved in showing the fan?
no idk. the first one is the bath. there's a crack in the sealant right by the taps that was there
sending now
is that them? the ones with the time stamp
Got them. Give me a bit.

Yeah the sealant's cracked in the bath photo but it's the same as the grout, it's just old. Doesn't look like damage to me. The fan's in one of the ones from the hall, you can see the cover, it's dusty but it's there.
I'd put it to him in writing and reference the photos with dates.
ok. home. he's going to be annoyed
can you help me write the email? i'm not great at this kind of thing
Yeah. Send me what you've got and I'll tidy it up.
it's a mess. one sec
ok i'll paste it

"hi tom, i'm disputing the €400 deduction from my deposit. the bathroom was in the same condition when i moved in, photos attached dated [date]. i'd like the full deposit returned by the end of the month"
That's good. Add the date you moved in and drop "i'm not great at this". Put the RTB reference in if you've got one. Send it tonight so there's a timestamp.
ok. the RTB thing is a bit beyond me but i'll look it up
thanks for doing this
You're grand. I'd have sent it hours ago.
lol sure
sent. he's read it already. no reply yet
Good. Leave it with him.
darragh can i ask you something
Go on.
do you think i'm a bad person for not paying you back
No. I think you've been in a hole and you didn't want to say so. That's different.
I'm not going to pretend it hasn't been annoying though.
fair enough
i really am sorry. not just for the money. for going quiet
I know. Thanks for saying it.
Get some sleep. Friday's still on.
yeah. friday's still on
